monitoring.intro: Weekly queue distribution, review indicators, and consolidated analyst feedback. No indicator on this screen uses the SAML-D ground truth.
monitoring.noPeriodBody: Use Process now on the Overview after loading transactions into the dataset.

tooltips.alertsLabel: Learn more about Alerts in the batch
tooltips.alerts: Accounts above the model cutoff in the selected week. Control sample accounts are not included.
tooltips.rate: Share of the week's active accounts that entered the model queue. The control sample is not included.
tooltips.reviewed: Queue alerts this week that received any decision (alerts table, status other than pending): Report to COAF, Archive (for any reason), or Escalate. Unlike conclusive decisions, which count only Report to COAF and Archive as confirmed false positive.
tooltips.reported: Queue alerts this week whose COAF report draft was approved in the reports table (status = 'approved'). Approval records internal review only; external submission to COAF is not enabled in this environment.
tooltips.countryRateLabel: Learn more about Alert rate by country
tooltips.countryRate: Alert rate by country, computed when the week is processed. Helps audit disproportionate concentration and possible geographic bias. Rates of 3.0% or more are highlighted.
tooltips.paymentRateLabel: Learn more about Alert rate by payment type
tooltips.paymentRate: Alert rate by payment type, computed when the week is processed. Helps audit concentration and possible bias across channels. Rates of 3.0% or more are highlighted.

monitoring.distributionSubtitle: Alert rates by country and by payment type to track concentration and potential bias.

monitoring.paymentEmptyTitle: No payment type rates for this week

feedback.title: Analyst feedback
feedback.intro: Indicators calculated exclusively from conclusive decisions recorded by analysts — both in the model queue and in the control sample drawn below the cutoff.
feedback.untilWeek: Cumulative up to the selected week
feedback.distinctionBody: Every alert with a decision counts as reviewed (including Escalate and Archive with insufficient evidence). Only Report to COAF (confirmed laundering) and Archive as confirmed false positive are conclusive decisions and feed the indicators and labels below.

cells.precisionEmpty: Waiting for conclusive analyst decisions to calculate precision.
cells.precisionEmptyHint: Report to COAF or archive as a confirmed false positive in the alert queue.
cells.precisionNote: {numerator} of {denominator} queue alerts with a conclusive decision{small}
cells.outsideEmpty: No control sample accounts have been reviewed so far.
cells.outsideEmptySampled: {sampled, plural, =1 {# drawn account awaits} other {# drawn accounts await}} a conclusive decision in the queue.
cells.outsideEmptyNone: No accounts drawn up to this week. Configure the sample size in Settings > Processing.
cells.labelsEmpty: No conclusive classifications recorded yet. Only Report to COAF and Confirmed false positive generate labels.
cells.newSinceNote: conclusive labels after the training of {version}
cells.newSinceZero: No new conclusive labels after the training of {version}.

tooltips.precision: Among model-queue alerts with a conclusive decision up to the selected week, the share confirmed as laundering (Report to COAF). Investigate further, Dismiss for insufficient evidence and the control sample are excluded. Below 20 cases, the sample is small.
tooltips.outsideLabel: Learn more about Laundering outside the queue, control sample, and recall
tooltips.outside: Every week, the control sample draws accounts below the cutoff without looking at the score. This indicator shows how many of them, once conclusively reviewed, were laundering: an estimate of what the queue misses. Without ground truth in operation, queue recall cannot be computed here; the recall measured in model validation is under Settings > Model.
tooltips.labels: Conclusive analyst classifications, stored separately from the dataset's ground truth. The latest decision on the alert always prevails. Report to COAF records confirmed laundering; Dismiss as confirmed false positive records not laundering. Investigate further and Dismiss for insufficient evidence create no label.
tooltips.newSinceLabel: Learn more about New labels since the active version
tooltips.newSince: Conclusive labels recorded after the active model version was trained. Retraining with analyst feedback needs at least 50 labels from closed weeks, with both classes (confirmed laundering and confirmed false positive).
tooltips.weeklyLabel: Learn more about Confirmed precision by week
tooltips.weekly: Weekly confirmed precision, model-queue alerts only. Weeks with fewer than 20 conclusive decisions are marked with an asterisk (*).

feedback.weeklyEmpty: No week with conclusive queue decisions yet.
feedback.weeklyEmptyHint: Record Report to COAF or Confirmed false positive decisions in the alert queue to track weekly precision.
feedback.compositionEmptyHint: These counters update automatically as conclusive decisions are recorded.
feedback.simulatedNote: {count, plural, =1 {# label comes} other {# labels come}} from the simulated analyst (generated from ground truth for testing), not from human review.
feedback.retrainSimulated: available when including simulated feedback (Settings > Model).
